evidence: lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:62-65: ensure_loaded! does an unlocked check and then calls load_locale. load_locale (lines 46-58) takes LOAD_MUTEX and checks again with `return if @loaded_locales.include?(locale)` before loading, so the mutex is never bypassed for the load itself. The unlocked check is the same fast path translate already uses (line 68). The only real gap is the `@loaded_locales ||= []` lazy init: in the worst case a locale gets loaded twice, which is idempotent and harmless.

config/initializers/i18n.rb:17: FallbackLocaleList#[] runs only when a translation is looked up, not when the initializer loads. The fallbacks module is only installed in i18n.rb, which Rails loads alphabetically after 05-site_settings.rb. SiteSetting.default_locale also has a declared default in config/site_settings.yml:59, so it returns a value even when no DB is available (05-site_settings.rb rescues StatementInvalid). No translation path calls it before SiteSetting is defined.

The initializer never calls ensure_loaded!. config/initializers/i18n.rb:21-23 only defines the method and line 24 assigns the list. The only caller is ApplicationController#set_locale (app/controllers/application_controller.rb:153-159), which runs right after it sets I18n.locale explicitly. Also, I18n.locale falls back to I18n.default_locale when unset, so it is never nil.

config/initializers/i18n.rb:1: the reviewer is right that the `# order:` comment is only documentation; no other initializer uses that convention (grep finds only this file). But the order is already correct: Rails loads initializers alphabetically, so i18n.rb runs after every numbered file, including 02-freedom_patches.rb and 05-site_settings.rb. The suggested name '03-i18n.rb' is worse: it would share the 03 prefix with 03-sql_builder.rb and move the file before 05-site_settings.rb for no benefit. At most, rename it with a prefix to make the dependency explicit.

config/initializers/i18n.rb:24 always sets I18n.fallbacks = FallbackLocaleList.new at boot. In i18n 0.7.0 (Gemfile.lock:126), I18n.fallbacks is defined in i18n/backend/fallbacks (required at i18n.rb:8) as `@@fallbacks ||= I18n::Locale::Fallbacks.new`, so it is never nil. set_locale (application_controller.rb:159) only runs on requests, after initialization. The gem source isn't installed here, so the 0.7.0 getter detail comes from the known gem source rather than a local read.
